name: Aoife O'Malley
bio: Aoife's motorsport journey began in her father's Dublin garage, tinkering with engines from a young age. She earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Trinity College before joining a junior formula team, quickly rising through the ranks due to her keen eye for detail and innovative problem-solving abilities. She believes in a data-driven approach to car development, focusing on extracting maximum performance from every component. Aoife is known for her meticulous nature and dedication to fostering a collaborative environment where engineers can thrive and push the boundaries of technical innovation. She is a strong believer in empowering her team to take ownership of their work.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy hair, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aoife has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor that reflects her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas and observations.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
